eventos.texto: Clínica Arenal, buenos días, good morning.
Hello, I'm calling from Med Supply. We have great prices on gloves and masks. Could I speak to the manager?

Nadie se ha despedido: el núcleo no deja colgar
I'm sorry, we're not taking sales calls. Have a good day!
La respuesta ya estaba pensada 1,6 s antes
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
